t: Let's just talk for a minute about First Rehabilitation,
what you offer, what's it all about, Dave?
Well, what we try to do is we try to make each one
as in what I mean is no cookie cutters.
Everyone gets evaluated, everyone gets treated,
In many industries, that's not politically correct,
Because some people are building up their rotator,
building up their knee, building up their ankle
to go back running, playing sports.
Other people are just wanting to get off the chair
and be able to make themselves a pot of coffee
So I wouldn't take everyone in consideration.
